2608.18878.title: DentAgent: Evidence-Centric Multi-Agent Coordination for Multimodal Dental Reasoning
2608.18878.paper_summary: Oral diseases affect billions of people worldwide, underscoring a pressing need for accurate and reliable dental assessment that integrates heterogeneous evidence from domain knowledge, radiographs, intraoral photographs, and 3D dental data. Most existing dental AI systems remain modality- or task-specific. Although recent vision-language models support flexible dental question answering, directly generated response leaves evidence implicit and untraceable. To address these limitations, we introduce DentAgent, an evidence-centric multi-agent framework, in which the Orchestrator coordinate five specialized agents spanning various modalities. Each specialist utilizes domain tools to convert observations into structured evidence records. The Evidence Blackboard manages these records as a shared evidence state, tracking coverage, gaps, and conflicts before response generation. This standardized evidence representation integrates isolated dental capabilities into a unified agentic workflow. Across four benchmarks, DentAgent demonstrates leading performance, even surpassing the senior specialists by 17.3 percentage points on multi-label diagnosis, which supports its value for broadly applicable and traceable multimodal dental reasoning, and highlights its potential as a technical foundation for population oral health assessment and management.
2608.18878.paper_summary_zh: 口腔疾病影響全球數十億人，凸顯出對準確且可靠的牙科評估的迫切需求，該評估整合了來自領域知識、放射影像、口腔內部照片和3D牙科數據的異質證據。大多數現有的牙科人工智慧系統仍然是特定於模態或任務的。儘管最近的視覺-語言模型支持靈活的牙科問題回答，但直接生成的回應使得證據隱含且無法追溯。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了DentAgent，一個以證據為中心的多代理框架，其中協調者協調五個專門的代理，涵蓋各種模態。每個專家利用領域工具將觀察轉換為結構化的證據記錄。證據黑板管理這些記錄作為共享的證據狀態，在生成回應之前跟踪覆蓋範圍、空白和衝突。這種標準化的證據表示將孤立的牙科能力整合到統一的代理工作流程中。在四個基準測試中，DentAgent顯示出領先的性能，甚至在多標籤診斷上超過了資深專家17.3個百分點，這支持了其在廣泛適用和可追溯的多模態牙科推理中的價值，並突顯了其作為人口口腔健康評估和管理的技術基礎的潛力。
